description: This file contains SQLAlchemy ORM model definitions for SQL Lab components in Apache Superset, including models for queries, saved queries, tab states, and table schemas, with associated properties and methods.

classes.name: SqlTablesMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing a property to process SQL statements into table objects, handling exceptions gracefully.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: ORM model representing SQL queries in SQL Lab, with properties and methods for query metadata, execution, and access control.

classes.name: SavedQuery
classes.description: ORM model for saved SQL queries, including metadata, relationships, and utility properties.

classes.name: TabState
classes.description: Model representing the state of a SQL Lab tab, including open schemas, queries, and related saved queries.

classes.name: TableSchema
classes.description: Model describing database table schemas, including JSON descriptions and UI state.

methods.name: get_template_processor
methods.description: Returns a template processor for SQL queries.

methods.name: process_jinja_sql
methods.description: Processes SQL with Jinja templating, returning table objects.

methods.name: naturaltime
methods.description: Converts datetime differences into human-readable strings.

methods.name: get_column_name
methods.description: Retrieves the column name from a column object.
